Substack Exporter – Get this Extension for 🦊 Firefox (en-US)

# Substack Exporter by rxliuli

Export Substack posts, comments, notes and subscriptions as Markdown, CSV, HTML or EPUB

Some features may require payment Some features may require payment

Available on Firefox for Android™ Available on Firefox for Android™

Scan the QR code to open this extension in Firefox for Android

Screenshots

About this extension

Substack Exporter saves Substack newsletters to your computer for offline reading and backup. What it exports 

- All posts of a publication, or a single post, as Markdown, HTML or EPUB
- Comment threads of a post as CSV, with reply structure preserved
- Notes and Reads of any user profile
- Your own subscription list

 About paid content: posts behind a paywall export in full only for publications your account already subscribes to. The extension uses your existing browser login and cannot bypass paywalls. Details 

- Works on substack.com subdomains and custom domains
- Can download all images in posts, so archives stay readable fully offline. Links in the exported files point to the local copies
- EPUB export packs a whole publication into one file for Kindle or Kobo
- Exports run in the background and resume where they stopped after rate limits, network errors or browser restarts
- Everything is processed locally in your browser. No data is sent to any server
